data.body: **[P2] Do not skip a replay-marked completion that is still pending.** A completion learned through `onOperationChange` can later reach `onOperationEnd` with `isReplay: true` because updated IDs are fixed at invocation start. This condition postpones the richer lifecycle hook until invocation cleanup; after its child context closes, the invocation view loses that parent and exports the continuation under `Invocation`. Treat an ID in `pending` as an unexported first observation, update `InvocationOtelPlugin` to create its continuation despite the replay flag, and retain cleanup draining only for completions workflow traversal never reaches. Add a test that receives a completion through `onOperationChange`, awaits it before returning from a child context, and verifies its single exported span remains parented to that child.
